note: Hand-written file contract for the R07 (Jacob) normal enemies G1-G3. Same 32 px rules as art 03 / R02-R06 (PPU 32, pivot (16,1), art faces right, flipX once on the parent, binary alpha). All three chase and touch only: no new boss, pattern, projectile, forced movement, debuff, invulnerability disguise or shared-health art. Gameplay numbers and the G3 left/right spawn placement belong to Core and the catalog.
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02-R06

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

edgeMargin.why: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of a frame, so Point filtering and flipX never cut the outline; ground sprites stand on the foot row = cell.h - 1 - pivot.y

assets.use: chase loop: a veiled scuttler on small clawed feet wearing one ivory mask. The expression changes inside the 4 move frames only (frames 0-1 smile, frames 2-3 scowl); the body and mask stay solid and opaque in every frame: no fade, ghosting, shimmer or other look that suggests it cannot be hit

heavy chase loop: a low, crouching predator (dark clawed legs, open fanged jaw) wearing a speckled hide over its back and head like a fleece, with a fake curled horn on the hood. The hide only mimics a flock; the creature is not drawn as a goat, sheep or other livestock

chase loop for ONE G3 actor: a single lean shadow runner with one swept horn on one side, one red eye and torn shadow cloth trailing. Each G3 actor is drawn alone with its own health; it is never drawn as a joined pair, twin bodies, a tether or a shared health bar. The 'two shades' are the two groups Core spawns on the left and right; Unity faces each actor toward its target with the parent flipX, so the two groups mirror each other (the single horn swaps side)

notProduced.shared-health / pair link art: not made on purpose: G3 actors have independent health, damage and kills (Core); no tether, joined outline or pair health bar
notProduced.left/right group marker or spawn effect: the left/right placement is Core's real spawn batch; no art marks the groups and no spawn effect is added
notProduced.invulnerability / disguise effect for G1: none: the mask changes expression only, and G1 is hit normally in every frame
notProduced.death / hit clips: not in the R07 brief; the existing shared enemy hit/death handling applies

motifs.source: Genesis 25:22-34 and 27 (the rivalry between Esau and Jacob, the blessing taken in disguise with goat skins, 27:16), 29:25 (Laban's deceit) and 30:32-43 (the speckled and spotted flocks). Creative adaptation for the game.
motifs.g1: deception as a veiled creature whose one mask flips between a smile and a scowl (a created monster; not Jacob, Laban, Rebekah or any person)
motifs.g2: the disguise of skins and the spotted flocks as a predator hiding under a speckled hide (a created monster; livestock themselves are not made demons)
motifs.g3: the discord between brothers as single shadow runners that come from both sides (a created monster; not Jacob or Esau, and not twin persons)
motifs.excluded: Jacob, Esau, Isaac, Rebekah, Laban, Rachel, Leah, the flocks and herds, the one who wrestled with Jacob, the angels of Bethel and God are never enemies or enemy effects. No human figures are drawn
